span-diagnostic.scope: MCU global esp_timer wall from UDP receive-return to send-entry, including preemption and RX observer work. Full packet/peer/MID/token/Block2/body checks and 48total read closure across both client modes. Logging follows send-return. Native outer select/delay wall intervals counted once, with nested counts separate; residual remains wall+preemption+observer work, never CPU. No taskCPU, RTT residual, clean-speed, cache-miss or peakRAM claim; no success-only subset on failure.
